Update (October 2): Many readers are interested in the full vehicle compatibility list for the Twelve South Airfly Drive. Our friends over at 9to5Toys just published that very list, worth a look!

Twelve South, a company behind a range of premium Apple accessories, has just unveiled a notable expansion to its Airfly lineup. Today, the company is introducing the Airfly Drive, an adapter that turns wired CarPlay into wireless CarPlay, available for pre-order starting today at $39.99. Here's how it works.

According to Twelve South, the Airfly Drive works with most factory-wired CarPlay vehicles — covering 75+ makes and models from 2014 onward. The Airfly Drive itself features a USB-A connector, but Twelve South includes a USB-C adapter in the box. It also features a compact aluminum design that's meant to stay plugged into your car long-term.

The Airfly Drive from Twelve South requires no apps or accounts. Users simply plug it into their car's USB port and pair it with their phone once during setup. After that, the Airfly Drive will automatically reconnect to start the wireless CarPlay experience. It can also support two paired phones at once, and users can switch between them with the press of a button.

Here are some of the specs and features Twelve South has listed:

  • Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto on your car's built-in display.
  • Plug and play with no apps, accounts, or charging required.
  • Fast, automatic reconnection every time you start your car.
  • Switch between two paired phones with the press of a button.
  • Compact aluminum housing designed to stay plugged in long-term.
  • Supports both USB-A and USB-C with included USB-A to USB-C adapter.
  • Works with your car's original display, buttons, and steering wheel controls.
  • Ongoing compatibility updates.

Wireless CarPlay is noticeably smoother than wired CarPlay, especially during short drives around town, offering a great quality-of-life improvement to the CarPlay experience.

Airfly Drive is available for pre-order today on Twelve South's website for $39.99, in black or white, with Android Auto support also included.
